title: NCRPO gets 73 new motorbikes to boost 911 emergency response

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Seventy three additional motorcycles were turned over to the National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) on Wednesday to reinforce the unit’s emergency response, particularly in areas with difficult road conditions. NCRPO chief Brig. Gen. Christopher Abrahano said the motorcycles will support Metro Manila’s 911 emergency hotline, enabling faster police response during heavy traffic and on congested roads. READ: PNP sees room for improvement in 911 system but still cites gains “These additional motorcycles will give our responders greater mobility and allow them to reach people in distress as quickly as possible,” Abrahano said in a statement.
